reference.name: Unofficial community decompiled Minecraft 26.x source index
reference.note: Behavioral port reference only. No decompiled Mojang source files are copied into this repository.

limitations: SM64CoopDX does not expose Minecraft item-use state or hunger attributes; optional SteveCraft.usingItem and SteveCraft.canSprint flags are adapter inputs.
Sprint is implemented through forward double-tap; a dedicated Minecraft sprint key binding is not present.
Input is sampled at SM64 frame rate and mapped from MarioState intendedMag/intendedYaw.
Default block friction is 0.6 unless SteveCraft.physics.set_block_friction_provider supplies a value.
Water, lava, ladders, crawling, flight, effects, mounts, attributes beyond exposed defaults, and block-specific collision behavior are not fully implemented.
SM64CoopDX remains the final triangle and wall collision resolver; this is not Minecraft's voxel/AABB collision engine.

methods: four-block default distance with scale/camera-distance multipliers
eight offset VISUAL/no-fluid collision ray algorithm
limitations: The ray algorithm requires a Minecraft-style block raycast callback and is tested independently, not wired to SM64 triangle queries.
SM64CoopDX Lua exposes camera yaw but camera position/focus are read-only; NEWCAM still owns the actual camera placement and collision.

validation.runtime_test: Not yet tested inside SM64CoopDX Android.
